THE INTERCEPT: Trump's 'Donroe Doctrine' Supercharges Violence in the Americas
May 27 | 🟢

📰 ACLED, the world's top conflict tracker, just published the receipts on the Donroe Doctrine.

195 civilians killed in US boat strikes since September 2025. Security forces across the hemisphere killed 6,900 people in one year — highest since 2018. Cartel drone attacks in Mexico up 567% from 2023 to 2025.

🔍 The Intercept names the CIA operations in Mexico, "Operation Total Extermination" in Ecuador, the strikes on civilian boats. Ecuador went from 24 gangs to 37 after US-backed leader takedowns. Every capture splinters the group.

• "U.S. pressure on organized crime is accelerating the spread of militarized security approaches in the region"
• 59 attacks on boats since September 2025, killing 195 civilians
• Ecuador's gangs grew from 24 to 37 after leader captures

🇲🇽🏭 SLIM CALLS MOODY'S DOWNGRADE "IRRATIONAL" — ANNOUNCES $5 BILLION MEXICO INVESTMENT

Carlos Slim dismissed Moody's Baa2-to-Baa3 downgrade as "irrational" at his annual press conference, arguing rating agencies ignore the capital actually entering the country.

Then he backed it with action: $5 billion in 2026 investment across infrastructure, energy — including the Ixachi oil field with 32 active wells producing 2,000 barrels/day — and telecommunications. Mexico posted record FDI of $23.59 billion in Q1 2026, up 10% year-over-year.

🚨🇲🇽 TRUMP RAISES US REFUGEE CAP — BUT ONLY FOR WHITE SOUTH AFRICANS

Trump lifted the US refugee ceiling from 7,500 to 17,500 — every new slot reserved for white Afrikaners. Between October and March, 4,499 refugees entered the US. All but three were white South Africans.

The White House claims they face "racial violence." Pretoria's response: the decision "ignores the deep historical wound of apartheid and denies the structural inequality that still persists." The UN rejected the claims outright.

🇲🇽🌎 SHEINBAUM: INE WON'T DECIDE WHO RUNS — PARTIES KEEP THAT POWER

Sheinbaum pushed back after INE president Taddei warned the anti-narco candidacy reform could make the INE "judge and party." The president clarified: the Verification Commission coordinates between the INE, security agencies, and justice institutions — but parties retain final say on nominees.

"Lo que se está proponiendo es que se ordene y que el partido político decida." The goal: screening narco-linked candidates before they reach the ballot, not expanding INE authority.

🚨🇲🇽 CHAPO'S NEPHEW CAPTURED IN NOGALES — US EXTRADITION ORDER ACTIVE

Mexican forces — SSPC, Sedena, National Guard, Navy, and FGR — arrested Isaí "N," nephew of Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán, in Nogales, Sonora. He coordinated logistics for the Sinaloa Cartel, managing synthetic drug production and distribution to the US and Costa Rica.

García Harfuch confirmed the arrest and the active US extradition warrant. Two long guns and ammunition seized on site.

🔥🇲🇽 CONGRESS RECEIVES FORMAL IMPEACHMENT REQUEST AGAINST MARU CAMPOS

The Cámara de Diputados officially received the political trial petition against Chihuahua governor Maru Campos, signed by 11 Morena deputies. The charge: allowing CIA agents to operate on Mexican soil without federal authorization.

Congress president Kenia López Rabadán confirmed the document must be ratified by May 29 to advance to the Pre-Examination Subcommission. The governor who opened the door to foreign intelligence now faces institutional consequences.

🚨🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM NAMES THE INTERNATIONAL FAR-RIGHT OFFENSIVE

Sheinbaum named the coordinated right-wing media campaign targeting her government — linking networks from Argentina, Spain, and the United States organizing "with institutions to harm governments that represent the people."

A national mobilization on May 31 will mark 8 years of the Fourth Transformation. "Seguir defendiendo lo nuestro, nuestra historia, nuestro orgullo y un gobierno que defiende a su pueblo."

🇲🇽🏭 EDOMEX HITS FDI RECORD — $1.7 BILLION IN Q1 2026 UNDER DELFINA GÓMEZ

State of Mexico attracted over $1.7 billion in foreign direct investment in Q1 2026 — the highest for any first quarter since 2018. Bajaj Motodrive, Nestlé, Tramontina, Unilever, and Mattel all expanded operations, deepening commercial ties with Brazil, Switzerland, and India.

Nationally, Mexico pulled in a record $23.59B in FDI for Q1. Edomex ranks 2nd with $6.37B accumulated since September 2023. This while Moody's says Mexico is one notch from junk. The money says otherwise.

🚨🇲🇽 79 ARRESTED, 1 TON OF DRUGS SEIZED ACROSS 15 STATES IN 72 HOURS

Federal security forces arrested 79 suspects across 15 states between May 22-24 — seizing 839 kilos of meth, hundreds of fentanyl doses, and 375 kilos of marijuana. In Quintana Roo, 28 human trafficking victims were rescued. Authorities dismantled 142 artisanal explosive devices, confiscated 49,530 liters of stolen fuel in Tamaulipas, and shut down a clandestine diesel refinery in Veracruz.

Army, Navy, National Guard, and FGR working simultaneously across border zones and interior states. These are the operations you don't see on CNN.

🇲🇽🏥 18.4 MILLION HOME MEDICAL VISITS — SALUD CASA POR CASA KEEPS BUILDING

Mexico's door-to-door healthcare program has completed 18.4 million home visits reaching 11.5 million people — with 30 million projected by year-end. Starting today, seniors and people with permanent disabilities can register for a new credential giving them access to any public hospital regardless of institutional affiliation.

The program delivers glucose and cholesterol testing, vaccinations, chronic disease prescriptions, and emergency referrals — all at the patient's doorstep. "More than 6 million glucose, cholesterol and triglyceride tests," said Welfare Secretary Leticia Ramírez.
